keys.signin.already: Already signed in today — back at {time}.
keys.signin.not_recorded: Sign-in could not be recorded just now.

keys.tut.win11_desc: Open Campaign and Stage {stage}. Tap all three hero portraits; a highlighted portrait means that hero is selected. Start only after all three are highlighted, then clear the stage.
keys.tut.quest11_desc: Open Quests and claim the completed Stage {stage} objective. The starter quest chain awards {hero} fragments toward your fourth hero.
keys.tut.skill_desc: Open Heroes, choose a hero, and raise one skill before Stage {stage}. Skill levels make that hero’s specific job stronger.
keys.tut.win12_desc: Return to Campaign and clear Stage {stage} with the same highlighted squad.
keys.tut.quest12_desc: Open Quests and collect the Stage {stage} reward. Claimable rewards are never added automatically.
keys.tut.rune_desc: Open Heroes → {hero} → Glyphs. Tap his first empty slot and build {glyph} with the two {frag} Fragments guaranteed on your first Stage {stage} clear. Later glyphs use named Campaign stages that you can replay to farm.
keys.tut.win13_desc: Return to Campaign and clear Stage {stage}. Guardian stages award hero fragments and can be replayed a limited number of times each day.
keys.tut.quest13_desc: Open Quests and claim the Stage {stage} objective for another {hero} fragment bundle.
keys.tut.wish_desc: Open the Wishing Pool and use a free Gold wish. Its result is random: a hero, hero fragments, or a named glyph fragment.
keys.tut.win14_desc: Clear Stage {stage} to complete the last starter fragment quest.
keys.tut.quest14_desc: First claim the Stage {stage} reward in Quests. Then open Heroes, choose {hero} under Ready to Summon, and press Summon Now. The four starter quest rewards provide the {n} fragments she needs.
keys.tut.vexxp_desc: Open Heroes → {hero} → Stats. Tap {potion} once. It gives {hero} {n} hero XP and cannot level her beyond Commander level. Claim this lesson after using the potion.
keys.tut.win15_desc: Clear Stage {stage} to unlock the guaranteed first Diamond wish.
keys.tut.gemwish_desc: Open the Wishing Pool and claim the free Diamond wish you earned. Your first Diamond wish guarantees a {stars} hero and gives you your fifth hero.
keys.tut.skipped: Tutorial skipped. You can start it any time from the menu.
keys.tut.not_saved: Tutorial choice was not saved. Please try again.
keys.tut.claim_failed: That reward could not be claimed yet.
keys.tut.basics_done: You’ve got the basics — now go build the strongest region in the realm.
keys.tut.offer_desc: Start here to learn one essential system before each of the first five Campaign rounds.
keys.isle.training_desc: Daily training grounds — twelve boss fights each for gold and glyph fragments.
keys.isle.emberdraft_desc: Draft heroes, forge equipment, outlast seven rivals.
keys.isle.tower_desc: Your hero against the endless swarm — how long can you last?
keys.isle.intro: Three trials drift among the clouds. Grow stronger to unlock each one.
keys.isle.prov_connect: Connect to play — Training Province battles are verified by the server.
keys.isle.no_plays_resets: No plays left today — {name} resets tomorrow.
keys.isle.no_realm: Could not reach the realm — check your connection.
keys.isle.well_battle_connect: Connect to play — Starless Well battles are verified by the server.

keys.isle.cue_barrowmaw: {boss} breathes a burning grave-cone and rushes the line with a stunning charge — spread out, keep the tank in front
keys.isle.cue_asterion: {boss} throws a lance down the whole line and hides behind a shard guard — save your burst for when it drops
keys.isle.cue_nymira: {boss}'s pollen slows and poisons the field and she heals herself — step out of the cloud and bring burst
keys.isle.cue_thorneveil: {boss} sets the ground alight with wildfire roots, then collapses it to stun — spread out and keep a cleanse
keys.isle.prov_intro: Two training grounds, twelve boss fights each. Win a stage to clear it and take its reward, then sweep your best cleared stage for the same haul. Two plays each per day — a loss costs nothing. Your account level opens the higher stages.
keys.isle.all_cleared: All {n} stages cleared! Sweep for daily rewards.
keys.isle.perk_banner: +22% squad power for the rest of the run
keys.isle.perk_momentum: +6% power for every wave you clear
keys.isle.perk_wind: Survive your next defeat — the run continues
keys.isle.perk_treasure: +80% rewards for the rest of the run
keys.isle.perk_phantom: 30% chance to skip a wave entirely
keys.isle.perk_fortune: +600 bonus gold every wave from now on
keys.isle.still_waiting: Still waiting for the server. Retry when connected.
keys.isle.gaunt_intro: Fight endless waves; every 3 waves you pick a powerful boon. One defeat ends the run — bank your loot and climb higher next time.
keys.isle.wave_pick: Wave {n} cleared — pick one to carry forward.
keys.isle.saved_locally: Loot is saved locally; retry banking when connected.
keys.isle.defeated: Defeated at wave {n}. Reached wave {r} — loot banked.

keys.isle.trib_desc: Claim a daily reward scaled to your record: {rw}
keys.isle.trib_locked: Reach Floor {n} to unlock the tribute.
keys.isle.too_weak_floor: Squad too weak for this floor.
keys.mail.empty_inbox: No messages yet. Guild and player messages appear here.
keys.mail.empty_war: No war reports yet. Attacks you make, raids on your castle, and defends appear here.
keys.mail.empty_mines: No mine reports yet. Send a squad to mine a node on the World Map.
keys.mail.empty_scouts: No scout reports yet. Scout a rival stronghold from the World Map.
keys.mail.war_rules: Declaring war starts a {countdown}. Nobody can attack during it — once it reaches zero the war goes {live}. A declared war lasts {hours} total, then must be re-declared. Declare war from a castle's menu on the World Map.
keys.mail.no_enemies: Nobody has declared war on you. You're safe from attacks.
keys.mail.no_wars: You haven't declared war on anyone. Open a castle on the World Map and choose {action} to attack it.
keys.setx.tos_intro: Last updated: {date}. {game} (the “Game”) is provided by {company} (“we”, “us”). By accepting, you agree to our {terms}, and our {privacy} explains how we handle your information. This page is a summary; the full text is at those two links.
keys.setx.tos_p1: You must be at least {min} (or older where your local law says so) to create an account. If you are under {adult}, or under the age of majority where you live, you need a parent or guardian's permission and supervision; they must agree to these Terms with you and authorize any purchases.
keys.setx.tos_p2: Keep your password private and do not share, sell or transfer accounts. Do not cheat, exploit bugs, use bots or unauthorized tools, or interfere with the Game or other players. We may restrict or suspend accounts that break the rules, and correct progress gained by cheating.
keys.setx.tos_p3: No harassment, threats, hate speech, sexual content involving minors, spam, impersonation or other illegal or abusive content. Report a message from chat, block players (your Blocked players list is in Settings), or email {mail}. Do not put passwords, payment details or sensitive personal information in chat.
keys.setx.tos_p4: Purchases in the Google Play version use Google Play Billing; the purchase screen shows the price and what you get before you confirm, and Google processes the payment. Diamonds, gold, heroes and other items are licensed for use in the Game, have no cash value and cannot be sold outside the Game. Refunds follow the law and the store's policy (Google Play's refund process); your statutory consumer rights still apply.
keys.setx.tos_p5: Your account details (username, a salted password hash, a recovery email if you add one), your game saves and activity, chat messages and reports you send, purchase records, and technical data: IP addresses, connection times, device and app information, and error and security logs. We use it to run the Game, keep accounts secure and play fair, moderate chat, deliver purchases and fix problems. We do not sell your personal information. Other players see your name, castle, game activity and the chat you send them.
keys.setx.tos_p6: Your account and saves are stored on our game servers and copied to backups for recovery. Routine technical, connection, IP and diagnostic logs are kept for {days}. Backups age out on their own rotation schedule.
keys.setx.tos_p7: Use {del} in Settings, or the request form at {form}, or email {mail}. The account is locked and hidden for a {grace}; signing in within those {n} days cancels the deletion. After that our servers wipe it from our database. Backups are not erased at once - they age out on their own schedule. A guest profile with no password is deleted at once.
keys.setx.tos_p8: The Game changes through updates and balancing and is provided “as is” to the extent the law allows. These Terms are governed by the laws of {law}; mandatory consumer rights where you live are not affected. We update the date above when the Terms change and ask you to accept again.
keys.setx.tos_p9: Questions, reports, privacy and deletion requests: {mail}.
keys.setx.tos_review: Please review and accept to continue signing in.
keys.setx.files_saved: {n} of {total} files saved on this device
